plan.failureSummary: Cached deterministic replay failed because the survey form layout changed and the cached selector for 'Last Name' is not present in the current DOM.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside the generated deterministic replay file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js:38:9).
Error message indicates failure to resolve selectors for 'Last Name *' / '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']'.
Failure screenshot shows the current form variation has 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead of 'Last Name *'.
Run was in DETERMINISTIC mode and is not a retry attempt.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and rerun test autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) and rerun the test so the autonomous agent dynamically inspects and fills the active survey fields.

additionalDataRequests.description: Confirm that the live DOM for the current survey variation uses 'Your Name' rather than 'Last Name'.

plan.notes: The survey form dynamically shifts layouts/fields between loads as designed. The cached instructions expected a 'Last Name' field, but the current layout presents 'Your Name' and 'Contact Email'. Regenerating the Page.AI cache will allow the autonomous agent to complete the survey based on the live fields.
